KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

2. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.

3. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. zito
   C. fupi
   D. nene

4. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.

5. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mato
   D. kitoto

6. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

7. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.

8. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

9. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

10. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Sokoni and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain -ake na -ao) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
